name: Payment template create edit archive
description: Verify payment definitions can be created, edited, and archived without breaking history.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /payments/items and click Yeni ödeme
The new payment form renders all required controls and save action
Create a monthly payment named TESTSPRITE TEMP PAYMENT with due day 15 and amount 123
The payment is saved and appears in the payment items list
Open TESTSPRITE TEMP PAYMENT for editing, change its amount to 124, and save
The updated amount is visible and the page reports no validation or server error
Open the same payment and use the archive action
The archived payment no longer appears in the active payment items list
